name: autoexec_schedule
label: Scheduled Job Information Table
description: The scheduled job information table is used for filtering on the status of automated operations, statistical time dimensions, and association queries for report generation.

fields.description: Global unique identifier, cross-environment import use, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: uuid
fields.description: Global unique identifier. This value must be unique in the database and is suitable for exact-match queries and duplicate detection.

fields.name: autoexec_combop_id
